reason_note: The project owner directs KU2D to remove semantic candidate selection from Data Acquisition. All technically valid, policy-compliant, sanitized acquisition records are accepted for handoff to Analysis; relevance, quality, ranking, deduplication and analytical inclusion are decided in Analysis. For the completed YouTube P50 batch, all ten retained candidates are approved for Analysis intake. This is not a claim that all ten are high quality, relevant, production approved or scheduled. The fallback instruction to select the first two is unnecessary because downstream progress no longer depends on an Acquisition-stage selection limit.

acquisition_responsibilities: deduplication only for exact technical duplicates when traceability is preserved
analysis_responsibilities: selection or exclusion for a specific analytical purpose
quality metrics and model-ready inclusion decisions
acquisition_human_gate_retained_only_for: material provider scope or quota expansion

provenance.source_context: Project owner approves all ten P50 candidates for Analysis intake and directs removal of Human candidate selection from the KU2D Acquisition stage.
